name: Crimson Feast only shortens Bloodsurge while a Cursed Form is active (#3413)
contract: Spell.dbc gives Crimson Feast 804602 Attributes 0x1c0 (SPELL_ATTR0_PASSIVE), DurationIndex 21 (infinite), Stances 0x0 and effect 0 = aura 23 (SPELL_AURA_PERIODIC_TRIGGER_SPELL) with Amplitude 5000 and TriggerSpell 804603. 804603 is effect 165 (SPELL_EFFECT_ASCENSION_MODIFY_COOLDOWN), MiscValue 553267 (Bloodsurge, RecoveryTime 180000), raw base points -5001, i.e. -5000 ms; Spell::EffectAscensionModifyCooldown applies that natively. The tooltip scopes the tick to 'every 5 second you remain in a Cursed Form', but Stances is 0 and nothing else gated the tick, so Bloodsurge's cooldown fell 5 sec every 5 sec permanently. Out of form the remaining cooldown must therefore fall by exactly the elapsed time; in form it must fall faster. Bloodsurge carries ExcludeCasterAuraSpell 802877, which the module grants while shapeshifted, so it is cast before the form is applied.
